evaluation_scope: One fixed reset seed per round used for selection; requires independent multi-seed shared evaluation before a walking claim
export_validation: 12-frame nonzero causal sequence including rollover; zero history before save and on fresh reload
loss: mean squared error against raw teacher actions; no clipped labels
method: supervised expert-action imitation with DAgger data aggregation

model_provenance.asset_manifest_scope: config, policy, and every XML/STL/OBJ in the G1 model resource directory
model_provenance.model_limitations: 12 actuated leg joints; upper-body joints are fixed; level ground only
model_provenance.policy_training: Published weights provide supervised action labels; student parameters are learned locally

observation_history_order: oldest to current; zero padding on reset; append current 47 observations before action
